adjudication.rationale: In the new addGuests handler, the CalendarEvent `evt` passed to `sendAddGuestsEmails` is constructed with `description: booking.description` and `organizer.email` set (`booking.userPrimaryEmail ?? organizer.email`), and no eventType privacy/gating fields are propagated (only `seatsPerTimeSlot` / `seatsShowAttendees` are copied). The new email/ICS path (`AttendeeAddGuestsEmail`/`OrganizerAddGuestsEmail` -> `generateIcsString({ event: this.calEvent, ... })`) therefore has no way (in this diff) to suppress organizer email or calendar notes/description for event types that might be configured to hide them, risking unintended disclosure.
